_: Surfaces the `tools/ui-catalog` harvest finds that no state in test/lib/states.mjs names, so no probe opens them (Issue #1466). test/ui-catalog.test.mjs crawls the catalog's own route list and reads the overlay triggers out of the committed docs/ui-catalog/index.html. A route is listed when a state's route resolves to the same hash shape; an overlay trigger is listed when one of its classes appears as a selector in test/lib/states.mjs, or its label appears there as a string or the tail of a text= selector. A trigger the harvest recorded without an element, as the keyboard lane does, is named by the `catalog` labels a state declares. A surface with no entry here fails the gate by name. The file only shrinks: once a state covers the surface, the gate fails on the entry until it is dropped in the same change.
